symptom: `mxcli report` (and `lint`) hangs for many minutes on a large project — appears to deadlock after "Catalog ready", 130-byte banner-only output, process pinned at ~140% CPU (not blocked → not a lock deadlock)
cause: O(N²) BSON re-decode: six lint rules loop `for mf := range ctx.Microflows()` and call `reader.GetMicroflow(mf.ID)` per microflow, but the modelsdk backend's `GetMicroflow` re-lists and re-decodes EVERY microflow unit on each call. N calls × N decodes → millions of full BSON parses. Diagnose with `kill -QUIT <pid>` (GOTRACEBACK=all) — the running-goroutine stack names the stuck rule + `ListUnitsWithContainer`
insight: Add `LintContext.FullMicroflow(id)` — loads ALL microflows once via `ListMicroflows()` and serves lookups from a per-run cache (safe: lint is read-only). Swap every `reader.GetMicroflow(mf.ID)` in a loop to `ctx.FullMicroflow(mf.ID)`. Turns O(N²) into O(N); report went from >40min hang to ~5s on 3259 microflows. Issue #720
